{{Quote|Welcome home, Lord Tyranus.|[[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]|audio=Sidious-WelcomeHome.flac|<ref name="AOTC" />}}
The '''LiMerge Building''' was [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious's]] secret hideout on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The building was located in [[The Works/Legends|The Works]] industrial district, near the [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]] and the crash site of the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']].

==Design==
{{Quote|Abandoned, perhaps, but not forgotten.|[[Dyne]] to [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]|<ref name="Labyrinth of Evil" />}}
This building, constructed as the headquarters for [[LiMerge Power/Legends|LiMerge Power]] some three [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] before its use by [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], was designed as a weapons manufacturing facility. Additionally, it was believed to have served as the corporate headquarters for the [[Factory/Legends|factories]] that surrounded it. The top two-thirds of the building appeared to be little more than an unadorned pillar with a rounded summit, and the superstructure of the lower portion was supported by massive fins reinforcing a circular base. Several [[Hangar/Legends|docking bays]] were located on the level where these fins met the structure itself. [[Permaglass]] [[Window/Legends|windows]] and skylights dotted the exterior of the building.<ref name="Labyrinth of Evil" />

==History==
{{Quote|Our agents persuaded them to use the eatery in Uscru, and the factory in which you find yourself&mdash;owned by us, as it were, through a holding company called LiMerge Power.|[[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]], to Darth Sidious|<ref name="Darth Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>}}
[[File:Sith_lair_The_Works.png|thumb|left|200px|[[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] meets [[Dooku/Legends|Darth Tyranus]] in the LiMerge Building at the onset of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].]]
[[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious used the LiMerge Building as his [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] headquarters during the training of [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> Following Maul's [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|defeat]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] became Sidious's new [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], and used the LiMerge Building as his base of Sith operations. Following his escape from [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], Dooku returned to his [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]] in their hideout on Coruscant to report the onset of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He also brought Sidious the plans for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Ultimate Weapon]].<ref name="AOTC" />

With Dooku leading the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the war, he was known to bring some of his [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|acolytes]] to the LiMerge Building, though none realized its connection to Sidious. Following the [[Assassination of Viento|assassination]] of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Viento]], [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] met with Dooku here along with [[Tol Skorr]] and [[Khaleen Hentz/Legends|Khaleen Hentz]].<ref name="Republic 63">[[Republic 63|''Republic'' 63]]</ref>

It was a mention of this location by the reformed Vos that clued [[Tholme/Legends|Tholme]] in to the true nature of the building, which in turn led to an investigation of the structure, carried out by [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Valiant (clone trooper)|Valiant]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Dyne]], and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]. Their search for Darth Sidious led through the building and into the downlevel tunnels, which they realized connected not only to areas of the [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]], but also to the lower levels of [[500 Republica/Legends|500 Republica]]. Getting to know this, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] became certain that Darth Sidious was in fact a member of Palpatine's inner circle. Due to the large amounts of footprints disguising Sidious' footprints, as well as a [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Separatist attack]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], Valiant and Dyne were the only ones remaining to investigate, as Mace Windu had to break off from the investigation due to the recent events. Dyne and Valiant eventually deduced only one organic lifeform within the area they lost Sidious' tracks at via basic holoradio channels (the military channels having been blocked out), and then entered an [[Turbolift/Legends|elevator]] to locate Sidious. However, they were killed in an ambush by [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] before entering the area Sidious was suspected of being at, although Dyne managed to live long enough to get a glimpse of Sidious when he inspected the damage, realizing that Sidious was in fact Palpatine himself.<ref name="Labyrinth of Evil" />

==Behind the scenes==
''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'' introduced the [[Factory District]] and placed both the [[Grungeon Block]] and the LiMerge Building in that district, but later sources moved them to the Works.
